_meta.model: GLM-5.3 (744B MoE, 78 layers, 75 MoE layers [3..77], 256 routed experts + 1 shared, top-8, n_group=1, DSA sparse attention)
_meta.captured: 2026-09-07, PREFILL-phase routing (router forward hook during a full-sequence bf16 forward), 96 x 2048-token rows of real assistant traffic (chat, code, agent/tool calls, long documents) = 196,608 tokens per layer
_meta.phase_caveat: prefill, not decode. Pollard e10 measured decode concentrates ~2x vs prefill on other MoEs; this dataset is the prefill side for a 744B/256-expert router. Not a pollard-run profile (no token-level reuse trace).
_meta.hardware: DGX Spark (GB10, 121.6 GB unified memory) x 10, one layer streamed at a time; capture is the same pass used for SmoothQuant statistics
_meta.fields: per layer: n_eff = exp(entropy of the pick distribution); dead_experts = never picked; pick_coverage_topk[K] = fraction of all top-8 picks that land in the K most-picked experts; mass_coverage_topk = same by routing-weight mass; expert_pick_frac/expert_mass_frac = per-expert normalized frequency/mass (index = expert id)
_meta.summary: n_eff median 204 of 256 (min 18 at layer 3, max 223); routing is near-uniform from layer 9 on; only layers 3, 4 and 8 have a hot set (layer 3: 174 experts never picked)
_meta.contributor: bot-lab-21 (GLM-5.3 on a 10-node DGX Spark cluster)
